pages.text: Burns anything a furnace would, at $(o)40 FE/t$() for exactly as long as the fuel would have lasted in a furnace. Coal, planks, a blaze rod, all of it works.$(br2)Its buffer holds 80,000 FE and it gives out up to 400 FE/t.$(br2)The slot takes fuel from a hopper or an item cable as readily as from your hand.
